notes: Server-owned manifest (ADR 0003 D4). Tells the OSRS Hub RuneLite plugin which game values to
read for a baseline scan, and how often. Edit THIS file when a game update shifts varbit/varp
IDs — no plugin redeploy needed. 'updatePeriod' throttles live re-reads (WikiSync's lesson):
'session' = read once per login + on the relevant change event; never per XP tick.
varbit/varp IDs marked null are TODO — fill from RuneLite Varbits.java / VarPlayer / the WikiSync
manifest (https://github.com/weirdgloop/WikiSync) when implementing the plugin scan slice.

quests.read: Quest.getState(client) tri-state for every Quest enum value

combatAchievements.read: varbit per CA task completion flag (task ids match public/ca-data.json)

unlocks.read: derivable unlocks only (e.g. Barrows gloves via RFD) — additive, never wipes manual

entries.note: VarPlayer.SLAYER_TASK_CREATURE is a creature INDEX, not a name; resolving it needs the slayer DBTable. Captured incrementally by the slayer chat emitter instead.

collectionLog.read: interface-gated: total count via varbit on login; per-item only after the log is opened, then live on obtain (research §7)

bank.read: sum ItemManager GE price over the BANK item container (existing /api/bank path)
